verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Slack's official MCP server, which lets external MCP clients use Slack's tools. That is the server role. Nothing shows Slack or Slackbot acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. App Directory integrations and external agents connecting into Slack are adjacent features and do not count as MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
